title: verify tenant isolation on all endpoints
description: Test that all API endpoints enforce tenant isolation by requiring tenant context via x-tenant-slug header or token tenantId, and prevent cross-tenant data access with appropriate 403 Forbidden or empty results.

title: test jwt cookie authentication flow
description: Verify the full JWT cookie authentication flow including login with valid credentials setting HttpOnly access and refresh tokens, refresh token rotation, access to /auth/me with valid cookies, and logout clearing cookies.

title: test appointments scheduling and status updates
description: Validate creating, reading, updating, and deleting appointments with tenant isolation, including status updates and conflict detection for overlapping appointment times.

title: test patients crud operations
description: Test creating, reading, updating, and error handling for patient records with tenant scoping and validation of required fields.

title: test staff and procedures management
description: Verify staff CRUD operations, procedure creation, and linking procedures to staff with role-based access control and error handling for non-existent procedures.

title: test pep medical records management
description: Test creating, finalizing, and adding addendums to PEP medical records with tenant isolation and validation of required sign-off fields.

title: test finance transactions and closures
description: Validate creating financial transactions, retrieving box status, closing cashier boxes, closing medical fee payments with validation, and tenant-scoped access.

title: test pdf report generation and access control
description: Test generating PDF reports for daily closures and medical fee repasses, ensuring tenant isolation and access control to prevent cross-tenant report access.

title: test schedule configuration and blocks management
description: Verify creating and retrieving schedule blocks with tenant isolation, validation to prevent overlapping blocks, and authentication enforcement.

title: test suppliers and expense categories crud
description: Test CRUD operations for suppliers and hierarchical expense categories with validation to prevent cycles and tenant scoping.
